description: This week's best UK smartwatch deals: Apple Watch from £194, Galaxy Watch 8 at £219, Garmin fēnix 8 at a record low, and prices worth paying.
intro:
**Short answer: for iPhone owners, the best smartwatch deal is the Apple Watch Series 11 (46mm) at £299 at Amazon, or the Apple Watch Ultra 3 at a record-low £495 at Argos. For Android, the Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 is £219 at Amazon, and runners should look at the Garmin Forerunner 165 at £139 or the fēnix 8 at £479.99.**

We picked 12 smartwatches from about £110 to £575, with prices reported or checked on 25 and 26 November 2026. Every card links to the retailer, and non-Amazon picks also get a link to compare today's Amazon price.

body:
## Quick picks

- **Best for iPhone: Apple Watch Series 11 (46mm) at £299.** It does everything most people want from an Apple Watch. On a budget, the SE 3 is £194.
- **Best for Android: Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 at £219.** £130 off and the best all-rounder for Samsung and other Android phones.
- **Best for running and outdoors: Garmin fēnix 8 at £479.99,** a record low. The Forerunner 165 at £139 is the best cheap running watch.
- **Best splurge: Apple Watch Ultra 3 at £495 at Argos.** It's cheaper than many Garmin flagships this week.

Prices come from TechRadar UK, T3 and the5krunner, and PriceSpy checks, on 25 and 26 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week. Most should last until Cyber Monday (30 November). For other deals live today, see our [Black Friday 2026 live deals](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/) or browse [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

## How to choose a smartwatch

**1. Start with your phone.** Apple Watch only works with an iPhone. Samsung and Pixel watches work best with Android, and Samsung's ECG and blood-pressure features need a Samsung phone. Garmin and Amazfit work with both, which makes them the safe choice if you might switch phones.

**2. Decide how much battery life you need.** An Apple Watch, Galaxy Watch or Pixel Watch needs charging every day or two. A Garmin Venu 4 lasts around a week or more, and the fēnix 8 goes for weeks. If you want sleep tracking, a long battery makes life much easier.

**3. Smart features or training features?** Apple, Samsung and Google are better at notifications, apps, payments and replying to messages. Garmin is better for running, cycling and hiking, with more accurate GPS, training plans and recovery advice. The Venu 4 sits in the middle.

**4. Do you need cellular?** A GPS model uses your phone's connection. A cellular (LTE) model can take calls and stream music on its own, but costs more upfront and needs a monthly add-on from your network.

**5. Pick the right size.** The smaller sizes (40–42mm) suit slimmer wrists and cost less. The bigger ones have a larger screen and slightly longer battery life.

## What's a good price?

- **Apple Watch SE 3:** under £200 for the 40mm.
- **Apple Watch Series 11:** around £270 for the 42mm and £300 for the 46mm, now the Series 12 is out.
- **Galaxy Watch 8:** £220 or less for the 40mm.
- **Garmin Forerunner 165:** £139 is good, and under £125 is excellent.
- **Garmin fēnix 8 47mm:** under £500 is its lowest ever.

Watch out for older models with big 'was' prices. The first Galaxy Watch Ultra and Pixel Watch 4 are cheaper than their replacements, but last year's watches have often been lower before.

## Get more from it

Runners and walkers can listen to audiobooks straight from an Apple Watch. Audible's Black Friday offer is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December; see our [Audible free trial guide](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/). Buying for someone who runs? Our [gifts for runners](/guides/gifts-for-runners-uk/) guide has cheaper ideas. If you're set on Apple, our [Apple Watch deals guide](/guides/apple-watch-deals-uk/) compares every model.

## Smartwatch FAQs

### What is the best smartwatch to buy in the UK?

For iPhone, the Apple Watch Series 11 at £299. For Android, the Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 at £219. For sport and battery life, a Garmin, from the Forerunner 165 at £139 to the fēnix 8 at £479.99.

### Are smartwatches cheaper on Black Friday?

Yes. Black Friday week is one of the cheapest times of year for smartwatches, and several here (Apple Watch Ultra 3, Garmin fēnix 8, Venu 4) are at or near their lowest prices.

### Is Apple Watch Series 11 still worth buying?

Yes, at £299. The Series 12 costs £329 for the smaller size and adds only small upgrades, so most people will be happy with the cheaper Series 11.

### Does a Garmin watch work with an iPhone?

Yes. Garmin watches work with iPhone and Android through the Garmin Connect app. You get notifications on the watch, but you can't reply to iPhone messages from it.

### What is the cheapest good smartwatch?

The Amazfit Active Max at £109.99 is the best cheap all-rounder, and the Garmin Forerunner 165 at £139 is the best cheap watch for running.
